crew.overview: Rome, 1957. A woman, Cabiria, is robbed and left to drown by her boyfriend, Giorgio. Rescued, she resumes her life and tries her best to find happiness in a cynical world. Even when she thinks her struggles are over and she has found happiness and contentment, things may not be what they seem.
crew.title: Nights of Cabiria

details.biography: Emimmo Salvi was an Italian writer, production manager, and director. He began his career in the 1950s, contributing as a production manager to films like Nights of Cabiria (1957). Salvi directed films such as The Stone Forest (1965) and Simbad contro i sette saraceni (1964). His work often explored adventure and fantasy themes, contributing to the peplum and adventure genres in Italian cinema.
details.name: Emimmo Salvi
